title: Recent Release, "The Battle for My Soul," from Christian Faith Publishing Author Charlotte Stanton, Reveals How Paranormal Curiosity Led to Spiritual Captivity

content:
Omaha, NE, September 25, 2026 --(PR.com)-- Charlotte Stanton has completed a new book, "The Battle for My Soul: A True Story of My Descent into the Occult and the Light That Broke Through Darkness," which chronicles her harrowing journey into occult practices. What began as an innocent quest to uncover proof of the unseen world gradually transformed into a terrifying obsession. Through Ouija boards, EVP recordings, spirit boxes, and other paranormal methods, Stanton found herself drawn deeper into experiences she could neither explain nor control. As fascination turned to torment, the boundaries between curiosity and captivity dissolved, leaving her trapped in a darkness that seemed inescapable.

The author's background as a licensed mental health therapist and business owner with over thirteen years of experience helping others navigate emotional and psychological struggles uniquely positions her to articulate the profound spiritual deception she encountered. Her introspective, creative nature—evident in her painting, writing, and artistic pursuits—brings authenticity and nuance to her testimony. A Nebraska native shaped by Midwestern resilience, Stanton's journey toward faith began in 2020 when she surrendered her life to Christ, marking a pivotal turning point from years spent searching for truth in false spiritual pursuits.

In "The Battle for My Soul," readers will discover how deception operates in the realm of the paranormal and how divine mercy intervenes even in our darkest moments. The stakes are deeply personal as Stanton unfolds the escalating terror, the invasion of her own thoughts, the loss of peace and sleep, and the slow unraveling of her identity. Yet this is ultimately a story of grace: an account of how God's relentless love broke through the chaos and led her back to freedom. Every moment recounted is authentic, raw, and soaked in spiritual truth that resonates with anyone who has struggled with darkness or questioned their own sanity.

From the author, "This book is my testimony that God's mercy reaches into every corner of our despair, no matter how far we've wandered or how trapped we feel. My prayer is that readers will see both the reality of spiritual deception and the power of God's redemptive love."

Published by Christian Faith Publishing, Charlotte Stanton's faith-filled work offers readers a candid examination of spiritual warfare and the transformative power of surrender. Her testimony illuminates the dangers of occult involvement while demonstrating that no darkness is beyond God's reach.

Readers who wish to experience this stirring work can purchase "The Battle for My Soul" at bookstores everywhere, or online at the Apple iTunes Store, Amazon, Google Play, or Barnes and Noble.
